decision: PHASE 5 RELEASE CANDIDATE PASSED — READY FOR PROTECTED REVIEW AND PRODUCTION HANDOFF

included: integrated production hardening across Funding Finder, Team Match, Funded Awards, Institutional Intelligence, and personalized alerts
public-evidence alert email content and bounded Strong-match explanations
desktop, mobile, accessibility, privacy, source-health, and no-drift validation
excluded: opportunity ranking, vector, or corpus changes

source_contracts.NSF: source-native award search and exact or reviewed controlled program-element lookup; official award links and source provenance retained
source_contracts.NIH: source-native RePORTER search and exact opportunity-number lookup; pagination remains normalized by core_project_num
source_contracts.DOE: isolated bounded PAMS adapter with public WebForms validation, independent failure handling, and exact DE-FOA deep links only
source_contracts.ROR: account-free organization registry lookup augments deterministic institution aliases while award queries retain canonical and source-specific institution identities
source_contracts.independent_failure_behavior: A failed DOE, NSF, NIH, or ROR request degrades only that source and does not suppress usable results from the others.

integrated_product.funding_finder: 37 frozen query cases preserve zero top-10 churn; Strong/Potential behavior, evidence explanations, Saved state, award deep links, and public source links remain on the existing v1.3.0 contracts.
integrated_product.team_match: Existing faculty selection, shared browser-local profile state, parent matching, hosted enhancement, and fallback behavior pass the production-like browser suite.
integrated_product.funded_awards: NSF, NIH, and independently isolated DOE source sections preserve query/history state, paging, public abstracts, official links, provenance, and partial-failure behavior.
integrated_product.institutional_intelligence: ROR-backed aliases and autocomplete, all-agency factual aggregation, filters, investigator/program drill-down, shareable URL state, no-key operation, and shared browser-local LLM configuration pass deterministic and browser validation.
integrated_product.alerts: Opportunity watches, baselined saved-search Strong alerts, exact controlled program watches, reminders, weekly digests, verification, manage, pause, resume, unsubscribe, suppression, retry, rate limiting, and idempotency retain the Phase 3 D1 and Worker architecture.

alerts.saved_search_baseline: Existing Strong matches are persisted at creation and do not email; only future new or newly qualifying Strong matches enqueue an alert.
alerts.program_identity: Exact controlled NSF program identities only; no fuzzy program equivalence.
alerts.idempotency: UNIQUE(subscription_id,event_key), claimed-delivery lease recovery, and stable Resend Idempotency-Key prevent duplicate lifecycle sends.
alerts.failure_handling: Failed provider sends remain retryable, the daily provider cap queues overflow, and authenticated idempotent webhook events suppress bounced or complained recipients.

email.provider: Resend behind the existing provider abstraction
content: agency and controlled program context when available
specific public change or reminder detail
bounded Why it matched evidence for saved-search Strong alerts
email.why_it_matched: The existing v1.3.0 query, retrieval, Strong rollup, and public explanation contract are reused with no profile sources and no LLM. Missing evidence is omitted gracefully.
email.formats: Immediate and weekly HTML/text messages carry equivalent factual content; HTML is a concise responsive single-column frame.
email.management: Existing verification, manage, one-click unsubscribe, sender, rate, retry, suppression, and provider idempotency behavior is preserved.
email.bounded_live_phase5_send: required after protected production deployment; deterministic mock/provider/content/privacy gates passed before merge

shared_link_image.root_cause: A static og:url made social scrapers identify every parameterized state as the bare canonical object, so cached preview identity could collapse or become stale even though the image itself was reachable.
shared_link_image.fix: Keep the search-engine canonical link, remove the collapsing static og:url, retain absolute Open Graph and Twitter image metadata, and explicitly provide og:image:url.
shared_link_image.state_preservation: No route, query, hash, history, or application-state parsing changed.
coverage: Funding Finder, Funded Awards, and Team Match state URLs

browser_local_only: AI chat and browser-local LLM credentials
privacy.defense: Worker subscription validation rejects unexpected or recursively private fields, and Phase 5 tests inspect the queued D1-bound JSON before rendering to prove private profile material is absent.

performance.method: Targets are release guardrails derived from observed production-like end-to-end timings on the deployed Phase 1–4 system, including expected hosted/source latency rather than synthetic component timing.
performance.interpretation: The shell and per-source progress remain responsive while independently bounded public/hosted requests complete; performance was not improved by changing ranking or building a new corpus.

frozen_retrieval_guards.search_release_package: current corpus, previous corpus, vector binary, and Worker allowlist verified

service_limits_and_release_capacity.capacity_assessment: The application cap is intentionally no higher than the provider daily cap. Overflow stays queued, and health exposes only aggregate state; normal bounded alert evaluation and public-source traffic remain within the stated deployment architecture.

deployment_and_rollback.rollback_selection: Worker rollback candidates are selected from the newest deployment carrying active traffic after deterministic created_on/id sorting; no workflow trusts the first deployment-list entry.
deployment_and_rollback.alerts_gate: D1 migrations, Worker deployment, phase5 health contract, smoke, and Pages/Worker coherence must pass on protected main or the workflow restores the prior active Worker.
deployment_and_rollback.award_gate: Worker health, deterministic source smoke, and Funded Awards/Funding Finder Pages coherence remain protected by prior-active-version rollback.
deployment_and_rollback.search_gate: Atomic Pages/Worker release-package coherence and bounded live Worker smoke retain prior-active-version rollback.
deployment_and_rollback.candidate_status: awaiting protected pull request checks and post-merge production handoff

known_limitations: DOE PAMS is a public WebForms system without a published machine API or rate contract; cold all-source award searches can approach the bounded source timeout while NSF and NIH remain usable.
NSF, NIH, and DOE retain source-native result ordering; no cross-source relevance rank is claimed.
NIH native multi-concept searches can emphasize a disease area without visibly evidencing every concept in the first records.
Broad DOE result totals may be source-capped and Funded Awards does not claim exhaustive retrieval beyond its bounded browse window.
Institution aliases are augmented by current ROR public metadata; ambiguous acronyms require a user selection rather than a guessed institution.
A social platform can retain its own prior preview cache; the release fixes URL identity and image reachability but cannot force third-party cache eviction.
